name: verify-mdk
description: Run and assess MDK runtime verification through existing engine, public app, process, CLI/daemon, and binding harnesses. Use when asked to verify behavior end to end, reproduce a runtime failure, choose an acceptance journey, check offline or restart recovery, or assess whether a run's evidence supports a claim. Select the cheapest execution boundary that exposes the required behavior, check build and runtime readiness, retain reproducible evidence, and verify cleanup. Test authoring belongs to test-audit; formal guarantees belong to formal-verification; delivery belongs to land-change.
